title: LibScript Component Manifest
description: Static metadata for a LibScript component

name.description: Unique identifier for the component (e.g. nodejs)

provides.description: Capabilities or aliases provided by this component

conflicts.description: Other components that conflict with this one

os_whitelist.description: List of operating systems supported by this component (or ['all'])

os_blacklist.description: List of operating systems explicitly unsupported by this component

arch_whitelist.description: List of CPU architectures supported by this component (or ['all'])

arch_blacklist.description: List of CPU architectures explicitly unsupported by this component

ports.description: Default ports used by the component

adapter_only.description: Indicates whether this component is an adapter/API-only wrapper that does not provide binary install/env lifecycles

category.description: Component classification group within the LibScript catalog

license_name.description: Human-readable full name of the software license (e.g. 'GNU General Public License v2.0 only')

license_file.description: Relative filesystem path to component's local license or copying terms document

license_url.description: Authoritative URI pointing to upstream legal terms or repository license document

copyright.description: Authoritative copyright notice stating ownership entities and foundation authors

variants.description: Standardized USE flag feature variants and compilation flags supported by this component

^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$.description: Configuration specification for a specific USE variant

default_enabled.description: Whether this variant is enabled by default

build_args.description: Structured compilation and configuration flags injected when variant is enabled

items.description: Required variant constraint (e.g. package[variant] or variant)

requires_variants.description: Inter-package or intra-package variant dependencies required when this variant is active

dependencies.description: Dependency requirements categorized by build lifecycle phase and criticality tier

items.description: Component or tool required on host (e.g. bison, meson)

host_tools.description: Tools needed on build host during bootstrap and compilation

items.description: Component required in target sysroot headers/libs during build

build_deps.description: Headers and libraries needed in target sysroot during build

items.description: Component required at runtime in rootfs

runtime_deps.description: Programs or daemons required in target rootfs at runtime

tier.description: Criticality tier of this component in standard stacks
